facts.founders_experience: Glean was founded by former Google executives with deep expertise in search, AI, and enterprise software. The founding team includes Arvind Jain (CEO), a former Distinguished Engineer at Google with over 20 years of experience in search and infrastructure, and Tony Gentilcore (CTO), who previously led engineering teams at Google working on search and knowledge graph technologies.

key_leaders.name: Arvind Jain
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & CEO
key_leaders.background: Former Distinguished Engineer at Google; led search infrastructure and knowledge graph initiatives.

key_leaders.name: Tony Gentilcore
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & CTO
key_leaders.background: Former Google engineering leader; specialized in search, indexing, and large-scale data systems.

key_leaders.name: Piyush Prahladka
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & Chief Product Officer
key_leaders.background: Former Google product leader; focused on enterprise search and AI-driven knowledge discovery.

facts.deployment_scale: Glean is deployed across large enterprises with thousands of users, supporting global workforces. The platform integrates with over 100 enterprise applications and manages petabyte-scale data.

capabilities: Unified access to information across workplace apps and documents

integration_requirements: Enterprise identity providers (e.g., Okta, Azure AD)
Cloud storage and document systems (e.g., Google Drive, Box, SharePoint)
CRM and productivity tools (e.g., Salesforce, Notion, Confluence)
APIs for custom integrations and data connectors
facts.complexity_notes: Glean offers a well-documented deployment model with support for hybrid and cloud environments. The platform provides extensive APIs and pre-built connectors for common enterprise systems, reducing integration complexity.

facts.monetization_model: Enterprise SaaS subscription with annual contracts. Pricing is typically based on user count and feature tiers.

facts.gtm_model: Direct sales with a focus on enterprise accounts, supported by a growing partner ecosystem including system integrators and resellers.

facts.fit_notes: Glean demonstrates strong commercial viability with a clear enterprise sales motion and a growing list of high-profile customers.
